platform_settings.theme_placement: A storelib_* id the theme's shopify/config/settings_schema.json declares is drawn where the theme puts it and left out of Storelib's panel.

live_preview.about: Events the builder's canvas dispatches when the creator changes something, so a script can redraw in place.

events.when: fired on `document`, detail `{ settings, live }`: the ids and new values of the settings that changed, on every value while a slider or colour is dragged (`live: true`) and once more on release. The canvas applies the change without reloading the page; a script that read a setting once can read it again here.

fired on the section's own element and bubbles to `document`, detail `{ sectionId }`: the section was drawn again in place after a change. A script that sets a section up once (a slider, a menu, a drawer) sets it up again for that section here.
